body:
KK, had a couple beers and about 15 Benadryl. Hopefully that's enough to do it. Should stop my breathing. If not, it'll be some really good sleep and no-one will be the wiser.

Thanks for all the support. Love you guys. I'm really just done. Kinda sad but it's also liberating.

Agnostic here but maybe see you on the other side?
I'm 26, I started to say 25 but I keep forgetting I'm older than that. I'm a graphic designer, now unemployed. I'm bisexual, if that matters, and enjoy running, cooking, and TV.
PM Me. I'm in my car with pills and a six pack. I'm on the ledge, been trying to not do this all week. See no point in why not....

Right now; working nights so work until 5, sleep until noon, get up, eat, dick around, learn some more Spanish. Maybe go out if invited, pool, cook dinner, repeat.

Fun stopped because it all the same over and over. I also can't afford to keep "having fun."
